fusions.name: Upthrust
fusions.desc: Drives the tines into the ground and jagged stone erupts around you, dealing 12 rock damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing each one 2 tiles back.

fusions.name: Fault Line
fusions.desc: Sends a crack running through the ground to the first enemy within 8 tiles, where it erupts for 30 earth damage and 80% of that to everything within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Standing Stone
fusions.desc: Plants a tine of stone that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedrock Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% rock resistance.
